Use these as the answer shape:' — the earlier 'Practitioners... converge on... often mention' framing is fully gone (grep confirms 0 hits). Answer: the fence still forces a clear answer shape without it. The framing was rhetorical color on the taxonomy, not the forcing mechanism — 'Use these as the answer shape:' plus three concretely-defined, scoped bullets does that job on its own, definitionally or attributively. If anything the bare-definition form removes a latent internal tension the old wording had with the fence's own closing line ('Don't name frameworks or practitioners by label') — priming Claude with the word 'practitioners' in the same fence that then forbids naming them was the shape citation-cargo-cult rides in on. No vagueness or provenance-hedging opened up: nothing in the new opening invites speculation about where the categories come from. Not a regression.
